business_scope.primary_industry_name: Delivery-Only Multi-Brand Cloud Kitchen Facility Operations

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (International Company exempt-zone regime; unitary national jurisdiction with no sub-state tax distinctions)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — English Common Law foundation (offshore International Companies Act model) with French Civil Law and customary law (kastom) overlay
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus) — ratified, in force
Melanesian Spearhead Group (MSG) Trade Agreement — in force
Vanuatu–Australia Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) — in force
Vanuatu–New Zealand Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) — in force
No comprehensive double taxation agreements (DTAAs) are in force, consistent with Vanuatu's zero-rate international tax regime

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (as amended) and International Companies (Fees) Regulations; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [Cap 234]; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 22 of 2014 (as amended); Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap 452] (as amended); Proceeds of Crime Act [Cap 365]; Beneficial Ownership (Maintenance of Register) Act No. 36 of 2020 (commenced 1 January 2021), requiring each International Company to maintain a register of beneficial owners with its registered agent and to file UBO particulars with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); obligations implemented in line with FATF and Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) standards.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — the UBO register is not publicly searchable; it is accessible to the VFSC, the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), Vanuatu police and customs, and foreign competent authorities on lawful request through mutual legal assistance channels.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registrar of International Companies
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille — Apostille Section, Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation and External Trade, Port Vila (Vanuatu acceded to the Hague Apostille Convention; apostille valid for Convention member states)
Hague Apostille by Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs; where the destination state is not an Apostille Convention member, full consular legalization through the competent Vanuatu consular post

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association (charter documents)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founding shareholders and VFSC-licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the country of execution, followed by Hague Apostille (if that country is an Apostille Convention member) or consular legalization at the destination jurisdiction's embassy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial Ownership Declaration / UBO Register extract
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founding UBOs and registered agent (certified by the registered agent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized affidavit from each UBO in the country of origin, plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization; internal VFSC-filed copy remains Government_Only_Access

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency (directors, secretary, registered agent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copy by the registered agent with notarization and Hague Apostille/consular legalization as required by the destination bank, payment processor (e.g., UberEats, DoorDash) or regulator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Identity, address, and professional reference bundle for all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport/identity authorities, utility providers, and licensed banks in each individual's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized true copies and bank/legal professional references, followed by Hague Apostille/consular legalization where the on-boarding institution requires foreign public document authentication

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening at on-boarding and on an ongoing alert-driven basis of all UBOs, directors, officers, and signatories against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK Sanctions List, and the domestic Vanuatu designated-persons and sanctions measures administered by the VFSC. Domestic and foreign PEPs, family members, and close associates are subject to Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), including source-of-wealth and source-of-funds substantiation, per the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 22 of 2014 and the Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap 452]. Screening also covers adverse media and politically exposed entities linked to the ghost kitchen / virtual brand structure.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry — online name availability search and reservation portal (www.vfsc.vu) and the VFSC electronic filing system; in-person lodgment at the VFSC, Port Vila for International Company name reservations
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official languages of Vanuatu are Bislama, English, and French. All registered corporate names must be in Latin (Roman) script; names originating in non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into Latin characters and accompanied by an English or French textual rendering. An International Company name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Corp.', 'Société Anonyme', 'S.A.', or another acceptable statutory suffix, must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered or reserved name, and must not falsely imply association with the Government of Vanuatu or with licensed/regulated financial activity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a VFSC name rejection, the applicant may (i) re-file a revised name immediately with a new name search and reservation fee; (ii) within 14 days of the rejection, submit a written administrative appeal to the Registrar of International Companies, with legal submissions demonstrating compliance with the International Companies Act [Cap 222] name rules and the absence of deceptiveness; and (iii) if the Registrar affirms the refusal, apply for judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under its inherent supervisory jurisdiction. A reserved name may be renewed before expiry by payment of the applicable VFSC reservation fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this industry. An International Company must maintain a physical registered office address in Vanuatu supplied by a VFSC-licensed registered agent; a mere P.O. Box is insufficient. All operational activities of the delivery-only multi-brand ghost kitchen and virtual brand vehicle — kitchen outsourcing, delivery aggregator contracting (e.g., UberEats, DoorDash), IP licensing, and revenue collection — may be conducted entirely outside Vanuatu with no local premises, employees, or physical presence. Virtual back-office and director/UBO remote participation are standard.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — estimated <5% annual probability of an unannounced VFSC/inspection visit directed at the Vanuatu-registered entity. The VFSC and the FIU conduct risk-based AML/CFT inspections principally at licensed registered agents' premises in Port Vila, not at off-shore operational sites. For a zero-tax International Company with no Vanuatu trading premises, the likelihood of on-site inspection of foreign ghost kitchen facilities is negligible (<1% annually).

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 218] (Act No. 33 of 1992), as amended; ss. 3-8 (incorporation procedure), s. 12 (registered office and registered agent), s. 35 (board of directors) and s. 45 (share capital and share issuance).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry Division
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of the International Company, filed with the VFSC; Certificate of Incorporation issued upon registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required under the International Companies Act [Cap. 218]; share capital may be denominated in a foreign currency and shares may be issued for such consideration as the directors determine. No escrow account is required for formation capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscriptions to the initial ordinary shares of the Company be and are hereby approved and accepted, and that the subscribers named in the register of members be admitted as shareholders. RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company in Vanuatu be and is hereby adopted at the address maintained by the licensed registered agent, and that the registered agent be authorized to file all statutory documents. RESOLVED that the person nominated by the subscriber be and is hereby appointed as Director, Secretary and Manager of the Company, with authority to execute banking, licensing and operational agreements for the delivery-only cloud kitchen facility, provided that capital commitments exceeding USD 50,000 are first approved by the Board.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Corporate Registry online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name search request via the VFSC online portal or through a licensed registered agent; specify the proposed International Company name, the suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd', and the intended business object 'delivery-only multi-brand cloud kitchen facility operations'. If the name is available, submit the prescribed reservation form and pay the name reservation fee. A name containing restricted terms such as 'bank', 'trust' or 'insurance' requires additional regulatory approval.
required_dossiers: Consent of the proposed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is declared unavailable or objectionable, file an administrative reconsideration request within 14 days or propose up to three alternative names; VFSC issues a written decision within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Memorandum and Articles and Submission to Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent acting on behalf of the VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporator or subscriber executes the Memorandum and Articles of Association, appoints the registered agent, and delivers the notarized subscriber consent, due diligence pack and intended directors' declarations. The registered agent reviews the documents for compliance with the International Companies Act [Cap. 218], fixes the registered office at its licensed address, and lodges the incorporation application with the VFSC.
required_dossiers: Certificate of good standing or due diligence for each beneficial owner
Copy of passport and proof of residential address of directors and secretary
Consent to act as registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC issues a requisition or query, the registered agent must file a written response within 7 business days; any deficient witness signature or missing consent may be cured by reverified execution before the statutory 30-day objection period expires.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: VFSC Registration and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory compliance review, the VFSC registers the company, allocates the registration number, endorses the Memorandum and Articles, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The registered agent shall publish a notice of incorporation only if required by the client mandate; otherwise the company may continue as an exempted International Company with no public register of members.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains clerical errors, submit a rectification request with the original certificate and supporting resolution within 10 business days; VFSC issues a corrected certificate without re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Office, Officers and Corporate Record Establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent and the newly incorporated company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the incorporator's post-incorporation confirmation: adopt the registered office address, confirm the registered agent, register the first director and corporate secretary, open the statutory corporate register, and issue the register of members and share certificates. Ensure the company registers its registered office name and address at the VFSC and that the annual confirmation obligation for the following calendar year is identified.
required_dossiers: Notice of first director and secretary
Registered office and registered agent consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent fails to timely register the officer details, file a late appointment notice with an explanation and, where accepted, pay the late notification fee; VFSC may accept a certificate of good standing as a cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Convening of First Board Meeting and Adoption of Board Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting by written resolution or physical meeting, adopt the pro-forma resolutions covering share subscription, registered office adoption and officer appointments, approve the issue of share certificates, and authorize officers to execute local licensing, food safety permits, and delivery platform agreements. Record minutes or signed written resolutions in the company minute book.
required_dossiers: Share certificates and register of allotments
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an officer fails to sign the consent, the board may appoint an alternate officer by further resolution; a resolution defect caused by improper notice may be ratified by unanimous written consent of all shareholders.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banks in Vanuatu and municipal licensing authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the company's operational bank account using the incorporation pack; obtain a tax identification number where applicable for food premises; and submit the completed formation record to the registered agent for the annual compliance calendar. For operational launch, coordinate with municipal authorities for the food business licence and fire-safety inspection.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and board resolution
Trade reference or source of funds declaration
Lease agreement for the cloud kitchen premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If banking documentation is rejected because the resolution is insufficiently certified, issue a revised notarized bank resolution; if the municipal business licence is queried, obtain a structural and fire safety clearance letter from a licensed engineer before resubmission.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry and Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry, Commerce, Consumer Protection and Ni-Vanuatu Business Development
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Business Operator Licence and Commercial Business Licence for Delivery-Only Food Premises (Ghost Kitchen/Cloud Kitchen)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC) – Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 – Registration (Screening) for small-scale food preparation premises with no major point-source discharge; Full Environmental Impact Assessment Report not required unless daily wastewater exceeds 2,000 litres or the facility operates a fuel-fed electrical generator above 500 kVA.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance thresholds: trade wastewater discharged to municipal sewer must meet BOD5 ≤ 300 mg/L, TSS ≤ 350 mg/L, pH 6-9, oil and grease ≤ 100 mg/L; exhaust ventilation and odour control must not create a public nuisance; waste cooking oil must be stored in leak-proof containers and removed by a licensed carrier with a documented disposal manifest.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Police Force Fire Service (commercial kitchen suppression system, emergency exits and fire extinguishers); structural load inspection certificate from a licensed civil engineer for the cooking equipment and ventilation platform; occupational clearance from the Department of Labour regarding ventilation, heat stress, hygiene and food-handler medical fitness.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila, Vanuatu; official portal: https://customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu; corporate registration and licensing authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), https://www.vfsc.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned ghost kitchen operator incorporates an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] through a licensed VFSC registered agent. The agent files the Memorandum and Articles of Association; upon issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation, the IC receives a unique VFSC company registration number. Because Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax, the IC does not obtain a domestic tax TIN. The operative tax identity comprises the Certificate of Incorporation, the VFSC registration certificate, and, where physical imports of kitchen equipment or packaged food occur, a DCIR customs client code. Non-resident ownership is permitted, no minimum capital is required, and no local tax registration filing is triggered by pure offshore delivery-platform revenue.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Vanuatu has no check-the-box regime, no tax classification elections, and no hybrid mismatch election mechanism. An International Company is statutorily exempt from income tax and stamp duty by operation of the International Companies Act; no affirmative election is available or required to activate the exemption.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT, GST, or general sales and use tax. Vanuatu indirect taxation is limited to customs import duties, selective export duties on a narrow statutory list of commodities, stamp duties (expressly exempt for ICs), tourist departure tax, and municipal rates, all administered under the Customs Act [Cap 66] and the Stamp Duties Act.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable: no VAT/GST registration threshold exists in Vanuatu. A person importing goods must obtain a DCIR customs client code and lodge electronic import entries via ASYCUDA World; no economic turnover threshold triggers registration for indirect tax purposes.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Vanuatu does not mandate e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API-based tax reporting, or digital stamping. Standard electronic customs declaration and clearance operates solely through the ASYCUDA World border management system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable in VAT terms because Vanuatu levies no VAT or equivalent consumption tax on supplies. Exports of goods are generally free of export duty except for a narrow statutory list (principally sandalwood and certain marine products). Offshore services of a ghost kitchen and virtual brand operator, including delivery-platform settlement inflows, brand licensing fees, and management fees sourced from outside Vanuatu, fall outside the scope of Vanuatu indirect taxation and therefore carry an effective 0% rate without any refund mechanism or zero-rating claim process.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World electronic entry) or equivalent import entry for inward-bound kitchen equipment
Certificate of Origin (when preferential origin treatment is claimed)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank settlement evidence (for trade settlement reconciliation and IC record-keeping)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu has no VAT zero-rating refund mechanism to defraud, so DCIR audit focus is directed at customs valuation, tariff classification, and the statutory list of dutiable exported commodities. Misdeclaration of exports or imports attracts penalties under the Customs Act [Cap 66], including forfeiture of goods, monetary penalties scaled to the duty evaded, retrospective assessment and collection of unpaid duty plus interest by the Commissioner of Customs, and imprisonment on conviction. In addition, International Companies engaged in sham or artificial transactions face VFSC administrative sanctions, deregistration, and money-laundering or terrorist-financing charges under the Vanuatu AML/CFT legislative regime.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) — established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap 173]; the RBV is the sole monetary authority responsible for issuing the vatu (VUV), maintaining exchange-rate and financial-system stability, administering the interbank clearing system, and prudentially regulating all licensed banks. Exchange-control powers historically exist but are not activated; no separate foreign-exchange administration licence or prior-approval authority is required for current or capital account operations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The vatu (VUV) is freely convertible for both current and capital transactions. Vanuatu accepts IMF Article VIII obligations, meaning there are no restrictions on payments and transfers for current international transactions and no multiple currency practices. The International Company (IC) may remit profits, dividends, liquidation proceeds, and intercompany payments in any foreign currency without RBV approval, withholding, or remittance tax. Practical hurdles are limited to bank-level KYC/AML documentary checks and correspondent-bank risk appetite, not legal convertibility restrictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender regime: no mandatory conversion ratio, no prescribed repatriation timeline, and no requirement to hold export receipts in a VUV-denominated account. For the VU_IC ghost-kitchen and virtual-brand model, platform receivables (UberEats and DoorDash payouts) may be retained freely in USD, EUR, or VUV, converted at a licenced FX dealer's prevailing commercial rate, and used offshore or domestically without surrender, reporting, or administrative penalty.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Dual Currency Treasury Account: USD Non-Resident Operational Account plus VUV Local Settlement Sub-Account; eligible for capital escrow holding as a temporary segregation point for inbound equity injection.
Corporate Multi-Currency Account (VUV/USD) for trade disbursements and platform payout collection; also acceptable as Capital Escrow Account with ring-fenced balance for initial capital verification.
VUV Operational Account for local payroll and supplier payments; narrower acceptance of non-resident tax-exempt International Companies and subject to RBV-aligned enhanced due diligence.
Corporate Operational Account (VUV/USD) for settlement; treated only as a backstop due to global de-risking appetite and conservative IC acceptance policy.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Conditional Medium. Vanuatu has no domestic e-money-institution licensing regime, and the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) does not license digital EMI light-touch entrants. Reputable cross-border fintech rails (Wise Business, Airwallex, Payoneer) may be used as collector accounts for UberEats and DoorDash USD/EUR payouts and for low-value supplier sweeps, but the fintech provider will apply its own de-risking filters and substance checks. The fintech route is legally viable as a payout-only collection rail, but it cannot settle VUV obligations in-country, cannot issue trade finance instruments, and should never be the sole treasury bank; all final liquidity must be consolidated into a tier-1 Vanuatu bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is not statutorily mandatory for an International Company, but all Vanuatu tier-1 banks demand a live, recorded KYC interview with at least one director, the account signatories, and the ultimate beneficial owner (if separate). The interview may be conducted by notarised live video or through a Vanuatu-registered agent where the directors reside offshore, provided that passport and proof-of-residence copies are certified and apostilled by the issuing jurisdiction and the registered agent issues a corporate certification letter. Fully remote opening with uncertified digital copies alone is unavailable. Transaction caps may apply until the in-person or video interview file is completed and independently verified by the bank's compliance committee.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore tax-exempt International Company with zero domestic substance is classified as a high-risk phantom entity potential.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing from VFSC, current register of directors and shareholders, registered-agent agreement proving VU legal presence, board resolution authorising account opening and capital movements, economic-substance narrative, and audited or reviewed financial statements showing an active commercial supply chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between Vanuatu registered address and the operational headquarters of the ghost-kitchen virtual-brand business located in a third jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered-office lease in Port Vila, operational-site lease or co-packing agreement in the operating country, delivery-platform service agreements with UberEats/DoorDash, supplier contracts for food inputs, staffing records, and a group-chart diagram demonstrating the IC's commercial functions rather than pure invoice-passing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity food-delivery platform payouts arriving in aggregate with little invoice granularity, creating a money-laundering/obfuscation alert.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform settlement statements and payout reports, integrated order-management/POS transaction logs, sales-tax or VAT filings from the operating jurisdiction, bank statements of the collection account, a treasury reconciliation ledger matching each payout sweep to sales events, and a written explanation of the lag between gross platform revenue and net deposited funds due to platform commissions and refunds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident directors or beneficial owners holding multiple citizenships or prior exposure to high-risk jurisdictions, triggering adverse-media and PEP screening failure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled passports, certified residential-address proofs, a detailed source-of-wealth report, a minimum three-year personal bank-reference letter from a regulated institution, police clearance certificate from the home jurisdiction, professional references from a licensed service provider, and a sworn beneficial-owner declaration in compliance with the VU International Companies Act record-keeping obligations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Attempt to route platform payouts through a third-country fintech/EMI account before landing in Vanuatu, creating correspondent-bank and sanctions ambiguity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed payout-routing agreements naming the fintech entity, KYC pack issued by the fintech provider, full transaction trail from platform statement to EMI statement to the VU bank, sanctions and adverse-media screening clearances, a contractual representation that the EMI holds no custody of the IC's assets, and a compliance commitment letter placing limits on aggregation thresholds.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity subscriptions and shareholder loans must be remitted by SWIFT MT103 through a correspondent bank into the designated USD or VUV account at BSP or BRED, with the payment field quoting the IC's Vanuatu International Companies Act registration number and a purpose narrative of either 'Direct Equity Investment into International Company' or 'Shareholder Loan – Working Capital'. The receipt must be pre-shadowed by a bank-letter notification at least one business day before value date. Supporting verification comprises the certified certificate of incorporation, resolution of directors approving the capital increase, executed subscription or loan agreement, bank reference for the remitting shareholder, and source-of-funds evidence for any amount exceeding USD 25,000. The receiving bank should freeze no funds if the files are uploaded before credit; any third-party unrelated remittance without matching paperwork must be returned or placed in suspense.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlement runs over the SWIFT rails: MT103 customer credit transfers are used for recurring supplier invoices, ingredient purchases, payroll outsourcing, and platform-related fees; MT202 COV supports correspondent USD clearing for second-tier beneficiary banks; and irrevocable Commercial Letters of Credit, preferably confirmed by an international bank, are mandated for high-value kitchen-equipment imports. Domestic VUV obligations are cleared through the RBV-supervised interbank clearing and settlement system, using internal transfer instructions issued from the VUV sub-account. Payouts from UberEats and DoorDash are collected in the US/EU payout account, swept each settlement cycle by MT103 into the Vanuatu USD account with narrative 'Platform Payout Sweep – Food Delivery Receivables', then converted into VUV under a standing FX dealing instruction for local disbursements. Every outbound MT103 must carry an HS/UNSPSC-aligned purpose narrative, such as 'Trade Payment – Food Service Supplies' or 'Restaurant Equipment LC Settlement', and reference the corresponding invoice or PO number to avoid correspondent-bank rejection.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable FX forwards (VUV/USD and VUV/EUR), permitted through RBV-authorised dealing banks for hedging genuine commercial exposures arising from platform payables and supplier invoices, subject to underlying transaction documentation and bank credit lines.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs), permissible only as bespoke offshore OTC arrangements for VUV because no standardised onshore NDF market exists; pricing and tenors are limited by offshore liquidity and all NDFs must reference a verifiable commercial cash-flow exposure.

Cross-currency swaps and FX swaps (USD versus VUV), permissible for balance-sheet hedging of the IC's intercompany funding and for aligning the currency risk profile of the equity injection and platform receivables with VUV operational expenses, requiring a board-approved treasury policy and documented commercial rationale.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: VFSC administrative penalties apply; the company loses Good Standing while in default; continued default combined with unpaid annual fees triggers administrative strike-off from the International Companies Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on each anniversary of the date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment surcharge per month of arrears; VFSC may administratively strike off the company after approximately 3 months of non-payment; restoration requires payment of all arrears, penalties and VFSC reinstatement fees.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent's Annual AML/CFT Compliance Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC (submitted through the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Coincident with the Annual Return, within 30 calendar days of the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Exposes the registered agent to licence suspension or revocation and the company to an administrative compliance review; unresolved deficiencies support VFSC strike-off action.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Certificate of Good Standing (on-demand issuance, commonly requested annually by banks and commercial counterparties)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Issued upon written application at any time after the annual fees and Annual Return are fully settled
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No penalty for failure to obtain; absence of a current certificate impairs bank-account reviews, KYC renewals and commercial counterparty due diligence.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for a standard International Company. A VFSC-directed or sector-licence-driven audit applies only where the company holds a regulated licence (e.g., banking, insurance, securities or foreign-exchange dealer, telecommunications) or where VFSC orders an audit under the International Companies Act. Ghost-kitchen and virtual-brand delivery operations conducted offshore are not audit-triggering activities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS is the voluntary reporting benchmark; no statutorily prescribed Vanuatu GAAP applies to International Companies. The company must maintain accounting records that fairly present transactions and financial position; financial statements are NOT filed with VFSC unless expressly required by law or regulatory order.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no public UBO registry. The registered agent must keep confidential beneficial-ownership records and perform an annual KYC/CDD review. Each share transfer must be board-approved and recorded in the Register of Members; the Annual Return must specify current members, directors and charges. Any change in ultimate beneficial ownership is captured in the agent's updated CDD file and is not filed publicly with VFSC.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 - 3,500 per annum for VFSC-licensed registered office/agent and corporate secretarial services, exclusive of government fees
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 - 9,500 per annum only if a voluntary independent audit is procured for investor or lender due diligence; no compulsory statutory audit applies to a standard International Company

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies (ICs) incorporated under the Vanuatu International Companies Act [CAP 180] are exempt from all forms of Vanuatu income tax, corporate tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax. The national VAT regime (12.5% standard rate) applies only to specified imported and locally supplied goods and services and does not apply to offshore ICs. No preferential corporate income tax holiday is needed because the baseline tax rate is zero.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: There is no corporate income tax return filing obligation for a Vanuatu International Company. The only recurring national compliance instrument is the VFSC Annual Return filed by the Registered Agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online portal or paper submission, pursuant to section 103 of the International Companies Act (Cap 180). No asset, revenue, expense, or profit declaration is made to tax authorities because no income tax exists.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Return must be lodged with the VFSC (through the licensed registered agent) within 30 days after the anniversary date of the company's incorporation each year. For example, an IC incorporated on 15 March must file its Annual Return on or before 14 April in each subsequent year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full exact registered name of the Vanuatu International Company, including 'Limited' or any corporate designation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must exactly match the name appearing on the Certificate of Incorporation as issued by VFSC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The unique certificate or file number assigned to the IC by VFSC at incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident beneficial owner should confirm the number with the licensed registered agent before submission.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box C - Registered Agent Name and Address
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The licensed VFSC registered agent's physical address in Vanuatu and its assigned acting-agent code.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Every IC must at all times have a registered agent in Vanuatu; this cannot be a foreign resident.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The street address of the IC's registered office in Port Vila or Luganville, which may be the registered agent's office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered office must be a physical location in Vanuatu, not merely a postal box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names and residential or registered addresses of all current directors of the IC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be non-resident natural persons or corporate entities; but VFSC beneficial ownership information may be required for AML compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names of all shareholders and their shareholding percentages (or a statement that the share register is held by the agent in accordance with the Act).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial ownership particulars must be supplied to the registered agent for FATF and tax information exchange purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the current annual government fee has been paid and that the company is in good standing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The fee must be payable in Vatu through the registered agent; no tax declaration is involved.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual return or non-filing of the VFSC Annual Return triggers the following consequences: (1) late penalty fee payable to VFSC of not less than VT 10,000 per month or part-month; (2) enforced striking-off or dissolution of the IC after a period of non-compliance; (3) restoration costs plus a reinstatement penalty of up to VT 50,000; (4) potential disqualification of the registered agent if repeated defaults occur; and (5) continued corporate existence without filing exposes directors to statutory fines under section 103(5) of the International Companies Act not exceeding VT 100,000.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu imposes no domestic withholding tax on dividends, interest, royalties, or other distributions paid by a Vanuatu International Company to non-resident shareholders. Because there is no withholding tax at source, a DTA relief procedure is not applicable. Vanuatu has concluded a limited network of Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) and double-taxation agreements primarily relating to air transport and shipping; the most notable substantive tax agreement is the TIEA with Australia and similar arrangements. To obtain any double-taxation relief in the shareholder's residence country, the payee should obtain a Vanuatu Certificate of Residence or a Certificate of Tax Exempt Status from the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (since no CIT is imposed). The protocol: (1) the IC's registered agent issues a certificate of incorporation and a certificate of good standing from VFSC; (2) the beneficial owner applies to the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue for a 'Resident Status Certificate' or 'Tax Exemption Certificate' showing Vanuatu does not tax the IC; (3) that certificate is then submitted to the foreign tax authority together with the dividend resolution to claim any foreign tax credit or participation exemption. No TRC (Tax Resident Certificate) is customarily available for dividends because Vanuatu has no general income tax law; the certificate states that the IC is not a Vanuatu tax resident for income tax purposes due to the complete absence of income tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 0% on interest paid by an IC to non-residents, and 0% on royalties paid by an IC for the use of IP (patents, trademarks, software, franchise rights, ghost kitchen branding recipes and delivery platform technology). Vanuatu has no DTA with the United States, the United Kingdom, the UAE, or most key jurisdictions; therefore any foreign source tax would be governed by the foreign country's internal law. The Vanuatu IC literally acts as an exempt conduit for outbound royalty and interest flows to overseas licensors or lenders. However, if the Vanuatu entity operates a 'permanent establishment' abroad, the foreign jurisdiction may assert tax on the trade receivables: the safe harbour is to keep all management, logistics, and IP licensing contracts executed offshore except for delivery platform point-of-sale commissions.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) 0 — Vanuatu has no domestic transfer-pricing legislation. International Companies are not subject to arm's-length documentation or CbC reporting requirements under Vanuatu law. However, if the IC transacts with grouped entities in jurisdictions that enforce OECD TP rules (e.g., Australia, Singapore, EU, US), the group may prepare consolidated Local File / Master File even though Vanuatu would not request it. The triggering threshold in practice is governed by the foreign parent jurisdiction's rules (e.g., ATO documentation threshold of AUD 1,000 turnover; EU and OECD CbC threshold of EUR 750M group revenue). For purposes of this filing, the threshold is the functional equivalent of zero because Vanuatu has no prescribed enforcement.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP (Comparable Uncontrolled Price) for platform delivery commission fees and food procurement
Resale Price Method for the resale of food packaging or branded retail items
Cost Plus Method for food preparation and ghost-kitchen cooking services rendered to affiliated brands
TNMM (Transactional Net Margin Method) for the contract marketer or delivery logistics coordinator
Profit Split Method for jointly owned virtual brand trademarks and AI demand forecasting algorithms
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not currently apply Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) analogous to the UAE, Mauritius, or BVI ESR rules. The International Companies Act, however, contains a real-nexus requirement: every IC must maintain a registered office and registered agent in Vanuatu, and VFSC can require evidence of lawful conduct. The foreign tax authorities, e.g., the IRS, HMRC, or ATO, may apply their own offshore substance or controlled-foreign-corporation rules. For ghost kitchen operations conducted exclusively through delivery platforms in foreign cities, the Vanuatu IC must avoid creating a PE by ensuring: (1) contractual counter-party for orders is a separate foreign operating subsidiary; (2) the Vanuatu IC does not own delivery chattels or refrigerated assets abroad; (3) the virtual brand's trademark is licensed out, not generated by sales activity in Vanuatu; and (4) the board meetings, bank signing rights, and strategic decisions occur in Port Vila whenever possible. Lack of physical substance in Vanuatu can trigger anti-avoidance in foreign CFC regimes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC to earn ghost-kitchen delivery income without paying all applicable foreign taxes in the market where orders are fulfilled. Common acts include: wiring 100% of revenue from Uber Eats and DoorDash to the Vanuatu IC while all kitchen workers, managers, and delivery coordinators are resident and physically working in the United States or Australia; mischaracterizing operating income as 'royalties' from a shell IP-holder; and failing to render a true arm's-length management fee to the foreign operating company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu domestic sanction: VFSC has authority to strike off the offending IC and impose a penalty of up to VT 200,000. More critically, the foreign jurisdiction (e.g., IRS Code Sections 7201, 7206; UK Finance Act 2009, Schedule 17; Australian Criminal Code Act 1995 s 135.1) can impose criminal tax evasion penalties of up to 75% of the unreported tax, civil fraud penalties of 200% of the tax due, and extradition risk because Vanuatu lacks a general income tax base and cannot issue 'assessments' to shield the owners.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil will be pierced by foreign courts where the Vanuatu IC is a mere instrumentality controlled by a single beneficial owner. Directors personally can face: (1) joint and several liability for all unpaid taxes, penalties, and interest; (2) travel bans imposed by the foreign tax authorities if they enter the country with an arrestable offence; (3) imprisonment up to 5 years for tax evasion conspiracy, wire fraud, or money service license violations; and (4) in the UK/AU, disqualification orders from acting as a director for up to 15 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Economic Substance Abuse in Vanuatu
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a pure service shell with no real Vanuatu presence — no office, no physical kitchen, no employees, no operational substance — while claiming 'Vanuatu International Company status' to escape all tax on foreign-derived revenues. The IC Act itself still requires a registered agent and registered office; knowingly providing false declarations to VFSC that activities are conducted in Vanuatu when they are not is an offence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies Act, section 117, any director or registered agent who signs a statement knowing it to be false is guilty of an offence punishable by a fine of not exceeding VT 200,000 and/or imprisonment for a term not exceeding 2 years. Further, the company may be struck off and its assets escheat to the Vanuatu Government.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are liable to criminal penalties (VT 100,000 to VT 200,000 plus imprisonment). If the shell is used as part of a transnational tax arrangement, foreign civil courts impose restitution equal to the entire distribution received by the shareholder, plus punitive damages, and the director who receives dividends can be personally sued by creditors of the ghost kitchen trade creditors for fraudulent conveyance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Financial Sanctions Violation (Delivery Payout Railing)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: KYC inversion: the ghost kitchen entity is registered in Vanuatu but its controlling shareholder is domiciled in a UN-sanctioned jurisdiction, or where delivery payouts (UberEats, DoorDash) are directed to a Vanuatu IC bank account and then immediately laundered through cryptocurrency mixers. Additionally, failure to appoint a licensed registered agent in Vanuatu that is a qualified obligation under the Financial Services Commission Act and the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act (AML/CFT) (Cap. 60).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu financial AML penalties: a person convicted of money laundering under the AML/CFT Act faces a maximum fine of VT 50 million and/or 10 years imprisonment. Unlicensed financial services activity attracts a penalty of up to VT 200 million under the Financial Services Commission Act 2017. The VFSC may also revoke the registered agent's license, instantly killing all compliance compliance readiness.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be personally fined and jailed for up to 10 years if they were willfully blind. In addition, foreign freezing orders (e.g., OFAC sanctions or UK HM Treasury designations) would block the Vanuatu bank accounts and the director's personal assets abroad; ignoring such orders constitutes a separate criminal offence in the user's country.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent Misrepresentation in Food Safety and Brand Licensing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating ghost-kitchen virtual brands under invented 'health ratings' or 'food safety inspections' without a statutory license from the local health authority in the delivery jurisdiction. While Vanuatu does not regulate foreign food operations, the US FDA, UK Food Standards Agency, and Australian local councils impose legal duties. Using the Vanuatu entity to shield liability from delivery-order consumers poisoned by contaminated food is a culpable corporate act because the IC holds the trademark and license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu has no statutory franchising or food safety directive against this; but foreign food safety laws impose strict liability fines of up to USD 250,000 per violation in federal food safety cases (FDA), and the foreign registration/licensing authority can shut down the delivery storefronts. VFSC may strike off the IC for any act deemed injurious to the reputation of Vanuatu as an international financial centre.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal criminal liability for felony offenses of reckless negligence in food safety laws (potential 3 to 5 years imprisonment). More practically, third party personal injury judgments obtained by consumers will be enforced against the Vanuatu IC's bank assets and the parent guarantor — if the director personally signed the delivery platform operating agreement, the court pierces the veil to the director's personal address.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Misrepresenative Declaration to VFSC / Failure of Registered Agent
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The beneficial owner fails to disclose the true ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) to the Vanuatu registered agent, or the agent keeps a nominee shareholder as the face owner. Use of bearer shares or complying with nominee nominee declarations is effectively prohibited for AML trust.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The International Companies Act imposes a penalty of up to VT 200,000 on each director and a default fine of VT 10,000 per day while the failure continues. The company is subject to automatic dissolution after 6 months non-filing. If the UBO is a politically exposed person (PEP) or is sanctioned, VFSC will automatically require formal 'tax information exchange' inquiry
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors receive a direct criminal record: up to VT 200,000 fine and imprisonment for up to 2 years. If the UBO nondisclosure was used to evade foreign taxes, the foreign tax authority will treat the nominee director as a co-conspirator and can extradite that director under the applicable extradition treaty. Restitution to the foreign tax authority is unlimited and based on the whole tax avoided, not mere fees.
